caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of fabric outlined in light grey, with the central portion filled with a delicate, intricate floral pattern. The pattern consists of winding stems, assorted flowers, leaves, and some small buds, all distributed in a balanced and repetitive manner across the fabric. Along the border of the square, a continuous vine-like pattern of flowers and leaves is visible, framing the central area. The main background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color, while the designs inside the square are rendered in very fine, pale grey lines, giving the appearance of embroidery or lacework on a translucent or mesh-like ground. There is also handwritten text at the top center of the square, reading "Sally Grand", in similar faint grey pencil.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
